messages:
alex.k: taking the bridge now for 23:00-07:00 UTC. quick perms/passoff — please confirm before I go fully primary.

sarah.l: thanks — quick checklist?

alex.k: 1) PagerDuty: primary = @alex.k secondary = @sarah.l. confirm in PD console -> Services > Oncall -> Redwood-Inference. If you can't see it, you need PD org role 'Responder'.

jeff.w: added confirmation: I granted @alex.k Responder on that service earlier today. @sarah.l you should still have Responder via team 'infra-oncall'.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: incident-bot created INC-489: elevated 5xxs on /v1/generate — triggered at 23:02 UTC. link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC489

pagerduty-bot: Alert routed: INC-489 assigned to alex.k (primary). Escalation policy: 5m -> secondary -> oncall-sre.

alex.k: next checks — AWS console and role assume:

  - aws sso login --profile redwood
  - aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/Redwood-Oncall-Bridge --role-session-name oncall-quick
  - export AWS_PROFILE=oncall-quick

if assume-role fails, run 'aws sts get-caller-identity' and paste error here. I have MFA on; let me know if you hit a prompt.

sarah.l: I can't assume-role, getting AccessDenied: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole on resource. I think my role mapping expired.

jeff.w: ok, @sarah.l — reprovisioned mapping for you. Try again in 30s.

sarah.l: ok now it works. :thumbsup: can see logs in CloudWatch /aws/infra/redwood/runtime.

alex.k: Grafana access: primary should have Dashboard Edit? Not required. Read access to 'Ops Overview' is enough to triage. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/overview. If you need elevated perms for alerting, ping grafana-admins or use the 'viewer -> helper' temporary token procedure in the runbook.

mike.t: note — if you can't get Grafana, use direct query: aws logs tail /aws/infra/redwood/runtime --since 5m --follow

alex.k: Runbook pointers:
  - Privs passoff: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall/privs-check
  - Incident triage: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/incidents/triage
  - DB failover (if needed): https://redwood-internal/runbooks/db/failover

jeff.w: coverage gap: between 02:00-03:15 UTC we don't have a secondary oncall (sarah is scheduled but has a meeting). Proposed temp: @mike.t covers escalation for that window. @mike.t confirm?

mike.t: I can cover 02:00-03:30 UTC. will be reachable on PD and Slack. I'll be listed as secondary in PD for that time.

alex.k: thanks. final pre-bridge checks for me:
  - pd: assigned OK
  - aws: assume-role OK
  - grafana: read OK
  - runbook links bookmarked

alex.k: handing off to self completed. if anything critical pops, escalate to @mike.t then @jeff.w. I'll post an update on status channel if we need a wider bridge. :wave:

sarah.l: noted. ping me if the error rate doesn't drop in 15m, I'll join bridge.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff complete: alex.k is primary (23:00-07:00 UTC), secondary mike.t (02:00-03:30 UTC), backup jeff.w. Handoff metadata saved.

alex.k: closing thread — will open incident thread if we need cross-team bridge. good luck team.
